verdict.line: You lose if you let Darkness Rise stack in a long poke war; you win almost every trade you start on your own terms.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser has no dash, blink, or gap-closer — his entire threat radius is Q (Obliterate, 675 range) and E (Death's Grasp, 700 range). Aatrox's W (Infernal Chains) reaches 825, which is further than either of those, so Aatrox can open every trade from outside Morde's kit and pull out with E (Umbral Dash) before Death's Grasp can catch him. The 53.7% Aatrox win rate over 147 games, plus the lane and solo-kill edge, comes directly from that range mismatch, not from raw stats.

theirWindow.what: Once he's landed 3 attacks or spells on you, his damage aura and Move Speed are live — disengage immediately rather than trading through it, since every hit he lands from here out hurts more and he'll stick to you.

yourWindow.when: right after Morde pops W to heal
yourWindow.what: Indestructible (cooldown 12/11/10/9/8s) is down for a full rotation once he consumes it. Land W (Infernal Chains) to drag him back into range, then Q-E-auto — there's no shield left to eat the damage.

start.why: 54.8% win rate over 135 games and the clear majority pick (70.3%) — the extra sustain and AD let you win the auto-trades Deathbringer Stance sets up without needing to back early.

boots.why: 54.1% win rate over 122 games and 73.5% pick rate — Mordekaiser's entire kit (Obliterate, Death's Grasp, Realm of Death) is magic damage, so the MR directly blunts his only damage type.

core.why: The omnivamp and shield on the two-hit proc reward the short, decisive trades this lane wants instead of prolonged skirmishing.
The proc heal on Q (Darkin Blade)'s first swing stacks with your existing sustain package, matching the 50% win rate 10-game core path.
Damage-over-time conversion lets you tank a Realm of Death commitment and still walk away with HP, per the recorded Eclipse > Sundered Sky > Death's Dance path.

situational.when: his magic burst from Obliterate starts one-shotting you through your shield window
he's stacking a large Indestructible shield every trade and it's eating your damage
the lane is going long and you need cooldown reduction to keep chaining Q resets

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacking adaptive damage and healing reward the extended-trade windows you're forcing whenever you catch him with W outside his own range.

summoners.why: 56.9% win rate at 81.8% pick rate — with the solo-kill advantage already in your favor, Ignite converts your range-mismatch trades into kills instead of just pokes.

playing.title: Open every trade with W first
playing.detail: Infernal Chains reaches 825, further than his Obliterate (675) or Death's Grasp (700). Land it before he can respond, then walk in — you're trading from a range he can't punish.

playing.title: Never poke through Darkness Rise
playing.detail: His passive activates after 3 landed attacks or spells on you. Don't trade in small increments that let him stack it for free — commit to a full Q-W-E burst or don't engage at all.

playing.title: Respect Death's Grasp before you swing Q
playing.detail: Getting pulled mid-Q animation strands you in his range with no dash up. Check his E is on cooldown (16/14/12/10/8s) before you commit to the Darkin Blade windup.

playing.title: Bank HP before level 6
playing.detail: Realm of Death isolates you completely and there's no outrunning it with E once it lands. Go into level 6 with a healthy HP lead so the duel is already decided before he casts it.

playing.title: Finish trades through Deathbringer Stance
playing.detail: Your passive's empowered auto scales off his max HP. Hold it for the exchange rather than using it on minions — it's the difference-maker in a close short trade.

playing.title: Punish his W cooldown window
playing.detail: Indestructible is 12/11/10/9/8s. Once he consumes the shield to heal, that's your green light to force the next fight before it's back up.

playing.title: Use R to close, not to poke
playing.detail: World Ender fears nearby minions and boosts your AD, healing, and Move Speed. Save it for a real all-in once his shield is down, not as a wave-clear tool.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the trade-pattern and cooldown-window reasoning is this brief's own tactical read, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being hit with (E) while using [Q]. Do not let his (P) continue to activate by dealing small bursts of damage.
